description: API #15: Transform unstructured project histories, prior contract summaries, and CPARS evaluation excerpts into Shipley Section L/M Past Performance Volume III citations. Outputs DoD Source Selection Performance Confidence predictions ('Substantial Confidence'), Relevance ratings ('Very Relevant'), Scope/Magnitude/Complexity matrices, FAR 42.1503 5-Factor CPARS justifications, Context-Challenge-Action-Result narratives, and gap mitigations.

bidder_role_and_context.description: Optional bidder context such as Prime vs. Subcontractor citation mix, Joint Venture / Mentor-Protege structure, or page-limit constraints.

project_history_text.description: Unstructured project histories, prior contract summaries, CPARS evaluation excerpts, or internal delivery notes to transform into Shipley Past Performance citations.

rfp_section_l_m_requirements.description: Raw text from the target RFP Section L (Volume III Past Performance instructions, recency/dollar/scope thresholds), Section M (evaluation criteria), and Section C/PWS technical scope.

name: generate_cpars_past_performance
